subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The king was ispired by this. (b) But it failed six times and succeeded the seventh time. (c) There one day he saw a spider trying to climb up the roof of the cave. (d) He then hid himself in a cave. (e) But by the irony of fate he was defeated each and every time. (f) He collected troops and made as many as six attempts to drive away the enemies. (g) He wished to regain his kingdom at any cost. (h) There was king who lost his kingdom being defeated by his enemies. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (h) + (f) + (e) + (d) + (c) + (b) + (a) + (g) Section B : Writing Test
